verses.en: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
verses.sm: O le faafetai ina ua aumaia le atolaau i le aai a Tavita Atua, ma ua tuu ai i totonu o le fale ie na faia e Tavita mo le atolaau; ona latou osia ai lea o taulaga mu ma taulaga faafetai i luma o le Atua.

verses.en: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua uma ona fai taulaga mu ma taulaga faafetai e Tavita, ona faamanuia ai lea e ia o le nuu i le suafa o le ALrr.

verses.en: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.
verses.sm: Ua tufatufa atu e ia i tagata taitoatasi uma o Isaraelu, o tane ma fafine, taitoatasi ma le potoi areto, ma le ipu uaina, ma le areto suamalie.

verses.en: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:
verses.sm: Ua tofia e ia nisi o sa Levi e auauna i luma o le atolaau a le ALII e faamanatunatu ai, ma faafetai, ma vivii i le ALI le Atua o Isaraelu;

verses.en: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
verses.sm: o Asafo o le sili, e aupito ane i ai o Sakaria, o Ieielu, ma Semiramota, ma Ikielu, ma Matitia, ma Eliapo, ma Penaia, ma Opete-etoma; o Ieielu foi na i ai napeli, ma kitara, a o Asafo ua faatagitagi i sumepalo.

verses.en: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.sm: O Penaia ma ÎIaaseelu o faitaulaga na i ai pu, e tumau pea i luma o le atolaau o le feagaiga a le Atua.

verses.en: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
verses.sm: O lena lava aso na faatoa tuuina atu ai e Tavita i le lima o Asafo, ma ona uso, o lenei salamo e faafetai atu ai i le ALn.

verses.en: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
verses.sm: Vivii atu ia outou i le An, valaau atu ia i lona suafa; ia outou faailoa atu i nuu o ana mea na fai.

verses.en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.sm: la pepese outou ia te ia, ia outou fai pesega ia te ia; talatala atu ia outou i ona vavega uma lava.

verses.en: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.sm: Ia outou mitamita i lona suafa paia; ia olioli loto o e sailiili i le ALn.

verses.en: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
verses.sm: Saili ia outou i le Alu ma lona malosi; sailiili ia te ia, aua le aunoa.

verses.en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.sm: Faamanatu ia outou i ana mea mamana na ia faia, o ona vavega, atoa ma faamasinoga a lona fofoga;

verses.en: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.sm: o outou le fanauga a lana auauna o Isaraelu, o atalii o Iakopo na ia filifilia.

verses.en: He is the LORD our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.sm: O ia lava o le ALn lo tatou Atua; o i le lalolagi uma lava ana faamasinoga.

verses.en: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.sm: Ia faamanatuina e outou e faavavau o lana feagaiga, o le upu na ia poloai mai i tupulaga e afe.

verses.en: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
verses.sm: O le feagaiga sa la osia ma Aperaamo, ma lana tautoga ia Isaako;

verses.en: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.sm: na ia faamauina foi ia lakopo e fai ma tulafono, o le feagaiga e faavavau mo Isaraelu;

verses.en: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
verses.sm: na faapea atu ia te ja, Ou te avatu la te oe le laueleele o Kanana, o le vaega lea o lo outou tofi;

verses.en: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.
verses.sm: a o toaitiiti outou, e toaitiiti lava, mona O tagata ese i lea mea.

verses.en: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;
verses.sm: Na feoai foi i latou i lea nuu ma lea nuu, nai le tasi foi itu malo i le tasi nuu;

verses.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.sm: ua le tuua e ia ia faasaua se tasi ia i latou; na ia aoai atu foi i tupu ona o i latou.

verses.en: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.sm: Ua faapea atu i ai, Aua le tago i e ua ou faauuina; aua foi le agaleaga atu i a‘u perofeta.

verses.en: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
verses.sm: la outou pepese atu i le ALn le lalolagi uma; ia outou tala‘i atu lana faaolataga i lea aso ma lea aso.

verses.en: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
verses.sm: Ia outou ta‘uta‘u atu lona mamalu i nuu ese, ma ona vavega i nuu uma lava.

verses.en: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.
verses.sm: Aua e silisili le AL11, e tusa ona matuā yua o ia; e sili foi ona matautia o ia i atua uma.

verses.en: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.sm: Auá o atua uma o nuu o tupua lava ia; a o le ALn na ia faia le lagi.

verses.en: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
verses.sm: O loo i ona luma le viiga ma le matagofie; o loo i lona afioaga le malosi ma le fiafia.

verses.en: Give unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.sm: Outou o itu aiga o le nuu, ia outou avatua i le ALn, ia avatua i le ALn le viiga ma le malosi.

verses.en: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
verses.sm: Ia outou avatua i le AL11 le viiga o lona suafa; ia outou avatu taulaga, ma outou o atu i ona luma, ia outou ifo atu i le ALn i le malumalu e matagofie.

verses.en: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
verses.sm: Ia outou gatete i ona luma le lalolagi uma; e faatumauina lava le lalolagi, ne‘i faagaeetia.

verses.en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
verses.sm: Ia fiafia le lagi, ia olioli foi le lalolagi, ia outou fai atu i nuu ese, O le ALn o le tupu lava ia.

verses.en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
verses.sm: Ia taalili mai le sami, ma mea ua tumu ai; ia fiafia le laueleele, ma mea uma o i ai.

verses.en: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD, because he cometh to judge the earth.
verses.sm: Ona alaiaga fiafia ai lea olaau o i le vao matua i luma o le ALM, aua o loo afio mai e faamasino le lalolagi.

verses.en: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.sm: Vivii atu outou i le Aw; aua e lele; lava o 1a; aua e faavavau lava lona alofa.

verses.en: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.
verses.sm: la outou faapea atu, Le Atua o lo matou faaolataga e, ia e faaola mai, ma faapotopotoina i matou, ma laveai ia i matou ai nuu ese, ina ia matou vivii i lou suafa paia, ia mitamita foi i matou i viiga ia te oe.

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.
verses.sm: la faamanu i le ALn o le Atua o Isaraelu mai le vavau e oo i le faavavau. la faapea atu foi Ie nuu uma, Amene, ma ia vivii atu i le ALII.

verses.en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:
verses.sm: Na tuua e ia o Asafo, ma ona uso i lea mea i luma o le atolaau o le feagaiga a le ALII, e auauna i luma o le atolaau e le aunoa, e tusa ma le galuega i Ièa aso ma lea as0;

verses.en: And Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:
verses.sm: o Opete-etoma ma o latou uso e toaono sefulu ma le toavalu; o Opete-etoma foi o le atalii o lutana, ma Hosa, na tofia e fai ma leoleo faitotoa;

verses.en: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.sm: o Satoka le faitaulaga, ma ona uso le au faitaulaga, sa i luma o le malumalu o le ALII i le mea maualuga i Kipeona,

verses.en: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;
verses.sm: e fai taulaga mu i le ALI i luga o le fata faitaulaga i taulaga mu, e le aunoa, i le tacao ma le afiafi, c tusa ma mca uma ua tusia i le tulafono a le ALI na ia poloai ia Isaraelu;

verses.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.sm: sa ia i latou o Hemana, ma lutana, ma e na totoe na filifilia, na ta‘uina atu o latou igoa, e vivii atu i le An, aua e faavavau lava lona alofa;

verses.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.
verses.sm: sa ia i latou o Hemana ma Iutana, ua i ai pu, ma sumepalo mo e faatagitagi ai, ma laaupese a le Atua. O atalii o Iutana, e fai ma leoleo faitotoa.

verses.en: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
verses.sm: O tagata uma na taitoatasi ma alu i lona fale; ma ua toe foi mai Tavita e faamanuia lona aiga.
